metadata.title: Micron Stock Sinks Again as Market Share Shrinks. Why That’s an Opportunity.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Drops Again as Its Market Share Shrinks. Why That’s an Opportunity.
Micron Technology stock is under sustained pressure. Figures showing its market share in dynamic random-access memory shrank in the third quarter might not help much but it’s more important to concentrate on the overall demand.
